issue.title: Pericope view Audit
issue.body:
Audit the Pericope view against related GitHub issues and expected behavior. Test the latest supported mobile build, document results, and create `dev ready` issues for any identified gaps.

**Done when:** The assessment is merged, all gaps are linked to actionable issues, and the audit result is posted to this sub-ticket.

comments.body:
## Pericope view audit — result

**Overall:** Pass with gaps

**Assessment PR (draft):** #583

**Assessment (on the branch until merge):** `docs/assessments/pericope-view/README.md`

**Build/env:** local run of merged `main` @ `4ebeae2` (`expo-dev-client` + Metro). UI and local-first scenarios ran against `dev.api.fluent.bible`. Scenarios checked in the backend database ran against a local fluent-api @ `acc1404` (Genesis and Exodus).

**Device:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29)

Pericope display works on device: the Settings toggle, Bible cards with range titles and recorded status, the Record title and pericope navigation, mixed-mode labels, the shared 5-take cap, stitched playback and offline use all pass. The main risk is that takes recorded in pericope mode never reach the server (#584), yet a chapter drafted with them can still be sent to Peer Check (#585). Whether pericope capture is acceptable for launch before range-take upload exists needs a product decision; #584 also needs a fluent-api change, to be opened at implementation time. #586 needs a product decision on whether verse coverage counts as a recorded pericope. The unit tap that does not open Record is the existing #564 (fix merged in PR #573, awaiting QA). Source-audio scrubbing was inconclusive and stays tracked on #408.

| Gap | Finding | Severity | Launch blocker | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Pericope takes never upload to the server; Sync Now is disabled when only pericope takes are pending | High | To be decided with product | #584 |
| 2 | A chapter drafted with pericope takes can advance to Peer Check with no audio on the server | High | To be decided with product | #585 |
| 3 | Pericope-mode completeness ignores verse coverage while the Bible tab shows the pericope as recorded | Medium | No | #586 |
| 4 | Mobile does not use `GET /pericope-sets/{id}` for sets outside the APK (follow-up task of #438, no user impact today) | Low | No | #587 |
| 5 | Pericope mode without local set data silently shows verses | Medium | No | #588 |
| 6 | Pericope take label is truncated on the Record tab | Low | No | #589 |

Will post the merged assessment link here after #583 merges.

## Pericope view audit — tests executed

These are the tests run to reach the results and gaps in this audit.

All tests were run on a physical Android device with access to Wi-Fi and mobile data.

### A. Settings

- **A.1** Opened Settings → Drafting unit. Expected: a Verse / Pericope control, with Verse selected by default.
- **A.2** Switched to Pericope, closed the app and reopened it. Expected: Pericope is still selected.
- **A.3** Switched to a second account on the device. Expected: that account has its own preference, Verse by default.

### B. Bible tab (pericope mode)

- **B.4** Opened a chapter on the Bible tab. Expected: a loading spinner, then pericope cards with no flash of verse rows; titles are verse ranges, never "Pericope N".
- **B.5** Expanded and collapsed a pericope card. Expected: the expanded card shows superscript verse numbers and a highlighted border; the collapsed preview has no verse numbers.
- **B.6** Checked the recorded status on the cards. Expected: a green check when every verse is recorded, an amber loader when only some are, and nothing when none are.
- **B.7** Toggled Verse ↔ Pericope. Expected: the list re-renders at the new unit.
- **B.8** Checked the source audio caption and waveform. Expected: the caption reads `Pericope N / total`; verse tick marks appear only when the source audio has verse timestamps.
- **B.9** Played the source audio and tapped or dragged the waveform to the middle several times, both while playing and while paused. Expected: playback seeks to the chosen position and does not restart from the beginning.
- **B.10** Tapped a pericope card. Expected: the card is selected and the Record tab opens.
- **B.11** Opened a pericope that spans two chapters from each chapter, with both chapters assigned. Expected: the card appears in both chapters with the full range and works from either.
- **B.12** Expanded the last card of a chapter whose pericope continues into a chapter not assigned to the user (Exodus 5:22–6:13), then opened it on Record. Expected: the text of every verse in the range, including the verses from the next chapter.

### C. Record tab (pericope mode)

- **C.13** Checked the Record tab title. Expected: the pericope range, with the pericope title as a subtitle when available, and no "Pericope 1 of 7" counter.
- **C.14** Used Next and Previous. Expected: they jump from pericope to pericope and are disabled at the chapter bounds.
- **C.15** Checked the source text. Expected: every verse of the pericope.
- **C.16** Checked the waveform of a recorded take in Pericope mode and in Verse mode. Expected: continuous with no tick marks in Pericope mode; verse tick marks in Verse mode.

### D. Mixed-mode recording

- **D.17** Recorded a pericope take. Expected: the label `Take N - Pericope - vv. X-Y` shows the full range, not truncated.
- **D.18** Switched to Verse mode. Expected: the pericope take appears on every verse it covers, with the same label.
- **D.19** Reached 5 takes on a verse, counting the shared pericope take. Expected: Record New Take is disabled.
- **D.20** Deleted the shared pericope take from one verse. Expected: it is removed from every verse.

### E. Stitched playback

- **E.21** Recorded verse takes for two or more verses of a pericope and switched to Pericope mode. Expected: one `Take N - Stitched - vv. X-Y` row with no delete action, playing the verses in order.
- **E.22** Played the stitched row with only some verses of the pericope recorded. Expected: the recorded verses play in order and stop; the Bible tab card shows the amber partial icon.

### F. Chapter advancement

- **F.23a** Recorded pericope takes for every pericope of a chapter and looked for the advance button without tapping it. Expected: the button appears only on the last pericope, once every pericope has a take.
- **F.23b** Recorded pericope takes for every pericope of a chapter, tapped the advance button on the last pericope, then checked the chapter status and its audio in the backend database. Expected: the chapter does not reach Peer Check without its audio on the server.
- **F.24** Recorded every verse of a chapter in Verse mode, switched to Pericope mode and opened the last pericope without tapping the advance button. Expected: the Bible tab shows every pericope as recorded, and the advance button appears on the last pericope.

### G. Sync

- **G.25** Recorded a pericope take, went online and opened the Sync page to upload it. Expected: the take uploads.
- **G.26** Checked the backend database for the pericope take's audio. Expected: an audio row exists for the take's verses.

### H. Offline

- **H.27** In airplane mode and Pericope mode, used the cards, the title, Next/Previous, recording and stitched playback. Expected: everything works offline.
- **H.28** Closed and reopened the app while still offline. Expected: Pericope mode and the pericope data are kept.

### I. Project without a pericope set

- **I.29a** Removed the pericope set from a project, chose Pericope in Settings and opened a chapter. Expected: clear pericope behavior or a visible explanation, and the advance button still reachable.

## Additional finding after the audit

Found in a re-test on 2026-09-30:

- **In Verse mode, a pericope take can be deleted with no confirmation, which removes the recording from every verse it covers.** → #623

@Roslin22

## Pericope view — retest

> **Note:** this test script was generated with the help of AI, from the tests executed in the #534 audit (epic #526) and from other information gathered while the issues were implemented. It is a guide, not a limit: any other test that covers these points or goes beyond them is also valid.

> **Linked issues:** when a test ends with an issue number in parentheses, for example `(#584)` at the end of G.25, that is the sub-issue that fixed that point, so you can open it to see what was changed. Some of these issues are still open or depend on work that is not finished yet (for example, fluent-api changes). Those tests are marked with "issue still open" or "may fail". For them, a failure may be expected for now: report what you see, but it does not necessarily mean the fix regressed.

A pericope is a passage of several verses (e.g. 1–5). The mode is chosen in Settings → "Drafting unit": **Verse** (one verse at a time) or **Pericope** (one passage at a time).

**What to prepare:** a project with pericopes (e.g. Mark 1; Mark 8–9 for a passage that crosses chapters; Exodus 5–6); access to the web app; two accounts on the phone; a project with no pericopes set up (ask the dev team or the PM). Uploading pericope takes depends on fluent-api (fluent-api#377 and fluent-api#391): until it is ready, tests F.23b, G.25 and G.26 may fail with the message "Missing Bible Text ID" on the Sync page.

### A. Settings

- [ ] **A.1** Open Settings → "Drafting unit". Expected: Verse and Pericope options, with Verse selected.
- [ ] **A.2** Choose Pericope, close the app and open it again. Expected: Pericope is still selected.
- [ ] **A.3** Switch to a second account. Expected: that account has its own choice, starting on Verse.

### B. Bible tab (Pericope mode)

- [ ] **B.4** Open a chapter on the Bible tab. Expected: a loading indicator, then the pericope cards, without showing the verse list first; the titles are ranges (e.g. "1–5"), never "Pericope 1".
- [ ] **B.5** Open and close a pericope card. Expected: when open, it shows small verse numbers raised in the text and a highlighted border; when closed, the preview has no numbers.
- [ ] **B.6** Look at the recording icon on the cards. Expected: a green check when every verse was recorded, a yellow/orange icon when only some were, nothing when none were.
- [ ] **B.7** Switch between Verse and Pericope in Settings. Expected: the list changes to verses or to pericopes.
- [ ] **B.8** Look at the source audio player. Expected: the text reads "Pericope N / total"; verse marks on the wave only appear when the audio has that information.
- [ ] **B.9** Play the source audio and tap or drag on the wave to the middle several times, while playing and while paused. Expected: the audio goes to the chosen point and does not jump back to the start. (#408 — issue still open)
- [ ] **B.10** Tap a pericope card. Expected: the card is selected and the app goes to the Record tab. (#564)
- [ ] **B.11** Open a pericope that starts in one chapter and ends in the next, from each of the two chapters (both assigned to you). Expected: the card shows in both chapters with the full range and works from both.
- [ ] **B.12** Open the last card of a chapter whose pericope continues into a chapter that is not yours (Exodus 5:22–6:13) and go to Record. Expected: the text of every verse is shown, including those from the next chapter.

### C. Record tab (Pericope mode)

- [ ] **C.13** Look at the Record tab title. Expected: the pericope range, with the pericope name below it when there is one, and no "Pericope 1 of 7" counter.
- [ ] **C.14** Use the next and previous arrows. Expected: they jump from pericope to pericope and are disabled at the start and end of the chapter.
- [ ] **C.15** Look at the source text. Expected: every verse of the pericope.
- [ ] **C.16** Compare the wave of a take recorded in Pericope mode and in Verse mode. Expected: in Pericope mode the wave is continuous, with no marks; in Verse mode verse marks are shown.

### D. Mixing both modes

- [ ] **D.17** Record a take in Pericope mode on a long passage (e.g. Mark 1:1–13). Expected: the name "Take N - Pericope - vv. 1-13" is shown in full, not cut off, and the take's time is still visible. (#589)
- [ ] **D.17b** Record a pericope take on a passage that crosses chapters (e.g. Mark 8:31–9:1). Expected: the name shows the full range, like "vv. 8:31-9:1", not cut off. (#589)
- [ ] **D.17c** Switch to Verse mode and look at a verse take. Expected: the name is still right, like "Take N - Verse - v. X". (#589)
- [ ] **D.18** Switch to Verse mode. Expected: that take shows on each verse of the passage, with the same name.
- [ ] **D.19** Reach 5 takes on a verse, counting the pericope take. Expected: the "Record New Take" button is disabled.
- [ ] **D.20** In Pericope mode, record a take for a pericope (e.g. vv. 1–5). On one of its verses, record a verse take (so the pericope take is not selected). Switch to Verse mode, open that verse and tap to delete the pericope take. Expected: the question "Delete pericope take?" appears naming the range (e.g. vv. 1-5); after confirming, the take is gone from every verse. (#623)
- [ ] **D.20b** Repeat D.20, but tap Cancel on the question. Expected: the pericope take stays on every verse. (#623)

### E. "Stitched" row (verses played in sequence)

- [ ] **E.21** Record takes on two or more verses of a pericope (Verse mode) and switch to Pericope. Expected: a "Take N - Stitched - vv. X-Y" row appears, with no delete button, and plays the verses in order.
- [ ] **E.22** Play the "Stitched" row when only some verses were recorded. Expected: the recorded ones play in order and stop; on the Bible tab, the card shows the yellow/orange partial icon.

### F. Sending the chapter to the next stage

- [ ] **F.23a** Record a take in every pericope of the chapter and look for the send-to-Peer-Check button, without tapping it. Expected: the button only appears on the last pericope, once every pericope has a take.
- [ ] **F.23b** Record a take in every pericope while the takes cannot upload (e.g. offline), and go to the last pericope. Expected: the send-to-Peer-Check button is disabled or shows a clear explanation that the audio has not uploaded yet; the chapter does not go to Peer Check without its audio on the server. Once the takes upload, the button works again. (#585 — issue still open; depends on pericope take upload, fluent-api#377/#391)
- [ ] **F.24** Record every verse of a chapter in Verse mode, switch to Pericope and open the last pericope, without tapping the button. Expected: the Bible tab shows every pericope as recorded, and the send-to-Peer-Check button appears on the last pericope. (#586)
- [ ] **F.25** In a chapter, record some pericopes with a pericope take and the others verse by verse (Verse mode). In Pericope mode, open the last pericope. Expected: the Bible tab shows every pericope as recorded, and the send-to-Peer-Check button appears. (#586)

### G. Upload

- [ ] **G.25** Record a pericope take, go online and open the Sync page. Expected: the Sync Now button is enabled, the take uploads, and neither "can't upload yet" nor "Missing Bible Text ID" appears. (#584; depends on fluent-api#377/#391 — may fail)
- [ ] **G.26** On the web app, open that chapter. Expected: the audio shows for the verses of the passage. (#584; depends on fluent-api#377/#391 — may fail)

### H. Offline

- [ ] **H.27** In airplane mode and Pericope mode, use the cards, the title, the arrows, record and play the "Stitched" row. Expected: everything works without internet.
- [ ] **H.28** Close and open the app while still offline. Expected: it stays in Pericope mode and the pericopes are still shown.

### I. Project with no pericopes set up

- [ ] **I.29a** Use a project with no pericopes set up (ask the dev team or the PM), choose Pericope in Settings and open a chapter. Expected: the message "Pericopes aren't available for this project. Showing verses instead." appears on the Bible and Record tabs, and the list shows verses. Record every verse: the send-to-Peer-Check button appears on the last **verse**. (#588)
- [ ] **I.29b** Use a project with a pericope set that is not built into the app (ask the dev team), sync and choose Pericope. Expected: the pericope cards appear. (#587 — issue still open; dev team test)
